warnings:
socket buffer below the minimum (4096 kB) at 1 of 3 points:
         remote-app (vr_server) @ metallica: 416 kB
       What overflows the queue becomes 'loss' in the report without being loss at the UPF -- and if it
       remains on one side only, the comparison between the paths reflects a difference of loss, not of path.
       Run ON THE NODE (they are global sysctls; the container does not see them):
         sudo sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=16777216 net.core.wmem_max=16777216
       To keep it after a reboot, write it to /etc/sysctl.d/99-tg2-vr.conf. On the core nodes (petshopboys, metallica),
       where there is no sudo, the way out is to lower the load profile until both sides lose equally.
